message: みんなの魔王
Time-sale bargains secured. Once I fill my stomach, special training begins.

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-ku~~n!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Huff, huff... I finally found you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai. What's wrong?」

name: Ria
message: 「You just went home without saying anything~」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, sorry about that. I was in a bit of a hurry...」

name: Ria
message: 「What were you doing?」

name: Synn
message: 「Shopping for dinner. When you're aiming for the best deals, you just can't miss a time sale.」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee. Honestly, Synn-kun, you're just like a housewife.」

name: Synn
message: 「My livelihood depends on it. Anyway, did you need something from me?」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Didn't you have some business with me?」

name: Ria
message: 「W-What was it again~」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't tell me you forgot?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ehhh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「You're surprisingly scatterbrained, aren't you, Ria-senpai~」

name: Ria
message: 「Wha!? N-No I'm not! I remembered it clearly right up until a second ago!!」

name: Synn
message: 「If you forgot, I guess it wasn't anything important.」

name: Ria
message: 「Gee~~z. Anyone who says mean things gets a bag che~~ck.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't have anything to hide, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「So pushy...」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, there's nothing in here except cabbage...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, tonight's dinner is cabbage rice bowl, after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「How do you make that?」

name: Synn
message: 「You sprinkle salt and pepper on cabbage and stir-fry it. Then you put it over rice, mix it with sauce and mayonnaise, and it's done.」

name: Ria
message: 「...And that's it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez!! There's no way a growing boy can get big on a diet like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's really good, though!」

name: Ria
message: 「Whether it tastes good or bad isn't the issue.」
Ria-senpai tugs me along forcefully.

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai? Where are we...」

name: Ria
message: 「As your senpai, I cannot overlook this grave situation. I will make dinner for you tonight.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Come on. We're going back to the supermarket~」

name: Synn
message: 「The flash sale is already over, I tell you!」

name: Ria
message: 「If you're going to stir-fry, you can't just have cabbage--you need other vegetables and meat too.」
Aside from those, Ria-senpai bought various other things as well.

name: Synn
message: 「Meat and vegetable stir-fry... Senpai, do you know how to make it?」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone's always teasing me and calling me an 'ojousama,' right?」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't think they're teasing you, though...」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm gonna prove to you that I'm really not like that~」
Saying that, Ria-senpai rolls up her sleeves and steps into the kitchen.

name: Synn
message: 「Should I help out with something too.」

name: Ria
message: 「'Please just sit back and watch TV or something\s04'」

name: Paqy
message: 「Getting to eat Ria-chan's home cooking feels like a dream!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What are you doing?」

name: Synn
message: 「Thinking about watching TV.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Analog broadcasting already ended, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Come to think of it, my TV is strictly for games.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's up with you? You're not acting like yourself?」

name: Synn
message: 「No... It's Ria-senpai today. She's different from usual--something's weird.」

name: Paqy
message: 「The Demon Lord is plenty weird too, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey! Ria-senpai is right nearby, so shh.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Who cares if she finds out? Ria-chan doesn't hate the Demon Lord that much, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Only the Kujou family's Demon Lord. Even so, confessing it now of all times--」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. Where's the salt and pepper~~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes!」

name: Synn
message: 「Here you go.」

name: Ria
message: 「Mm, thanks♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Should I at least set out the plates?」

name: Ria
message: 「It's fine, leave it to me. So, do you want a bath first? Or dinner?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Dinner.」

name: Ria
message: 「Got it♪ Just wait a little longer, okay.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「She's weird. She really is weird.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey. Insult Ria-chan any further and my pupils are gonna shoot fire.」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean, the bath is right in the kitchen, yet she's asking things like, 'Bath first? Or dinner?'」

name: Paqy
message: 「What the heck is that? Sounds just like a line from a newlywed.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha, no way.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Barging into your room with no real business just to cook dinner--she's practically a self-invited bride, isn't she?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's almost like she has feelings for me.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, that wouldn't happen even if heaven and earth mashed together.」

name: Synn
message: 「You really have the nerve to say that with this mouth, huh.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hyah, st-stop iiit!」

name: Ria
message: 「Kyaaa!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gyaaa!!」
The wok erupts into massive flames!! Ria-senpai is sitting flat on her rear, clutching her hand.
I grab Ria-senpai's hand and thrust it into the sink.
Then, with my other hand, I place a lid over the wok to put out the fire for the time being. It didn't turn into a total disaster.

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai. Does your hand hurt?」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I'm okay. It startled me, so I pulled my hand back right away.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Thank goodness for that.」
I lift the lid and check the contents of the wok.

name: Ria
message: 「Oops... It got a little burnt, didn't it.」

name: Synn
message: 「How did that even happen?」

name: Ria
message: 「I tried adding some wine for extra aroma, you see... and the flames flared up way higher than I expected.\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Wine... in stir-fried vegetables?」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-yeah. Since I was going through the trouble, I wondered if I could make it even more delicious. Guess I messed up.\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「W-what... I'm already happy enough just having you cook for me, Senpai, and to think you put that much thought into it...」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, stop it--. You're way too good at flattering people--」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean it! I mean, you came all the way to my house, cooked a meal for me, and even looked out for my health.」

name: Ria
message: 「M-my health, you say...\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「Having someone go that far for me makes me a lucky guy.」

name: Ria
message: 「Maybe it's because it's you, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh.」

name: Ria
message: 「Because it's you, Synn-kun, I just find myself wanting to do these things for you, I guess.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai... does that mean...」

name: Ria
message: 「I mean, I just can't leave you alone.\s04」
So she really does see herself as my guardian, huh...

name: Ria
message: 「Though lately... that's started to change a little.」

name: Ria
message: 「Thank you for saving me earlier... okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「Honestly, I might have gotten burned a little\s02 But you got water ready right away, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's serious!!」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm totally fine. Look, see? Not even a mark, right?」
Ria-senpai holds out her hand and brings her fingers close to my face.
And just like that, she goes to touch my cheek with her palm--

name: Synn
message: 「Sen... pai?」
She hurriedly pulls her hand back.

name: Ria
message: 「W-What am I... doing right now...」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Sorry. I didn't mean to startle you.」
Her face had gotten close enough that I could feel her warm breath.
What would have happened if I hadn't spoken up right then?

name: Ria
message: 「Ah!! Back to making dinner. I won't push myself this time, so just wait a tiny bit longer, okay♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes...」
Paqy, whom I reflexively threw, is stuck in the wall. Since Ria-senpai is safe, I'm sure Paqy has no regrets.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I guess I'll get some studying done.」
If I slack off, I'll just end up panicking during exams again.
And I can't keep relying on Ria-senpai's help all over again.
Senpai is going to graduate next year, after all.
Senpai...

name: Ria
message: 「Oh my~? Studying, are we? How admirable♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, is it all done?」

name: Ria
message: 「Here's some super nutritious, carotene-packed meat and veggie stir-fry!」
And so, the two of us sit down around the table.

name: Synn & Ria
message: 「Thanks for the food!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, this is delicious!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmph-hmph!」

name: Synn
message: 「Is the secret ingredient of wine what ties it together?」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez! We agreed not to talk about that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha.」
We fill our stomachs with a much more lavish meal than cabbage bowls.
I made sure to leave a portion for Paqy too, of course.

name: Paqy
message: 「De... Demon... L... ord...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Pepsi!!」
I really can't let my guard down for even a second.

name: Ria
message: 「Huh... Demon Lord...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahahaha. Just because Ria-senpai admires him doesn't mean you have to get so competitive, Paqy, you silly bird.」

name: Ria
message: 「You still remembered that story...?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, it's come up in conversation a few times.」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No way... Jeez, just forget about it already...\s03」
Phew. Looks like I managed to keep my cover from blowing.

name: Ria
message: 「Are you curious about the Demon Lord too, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, to a degree. After all, he's connected to Re-Crea, right? Ahaha.」

name: Ria
message: 「I wonder... if that's really true...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「Dangerous Demons are increasing, and there are even rumors of stronger Demons. Even though things are still far from safe...」

name: Ria
message: 「No matter how long we wait, the Demon Lord never shows up.」

name: Ria
message: 「Lately, I've even started thinking that maybe the Demon Lord doesn't actually exist...」
The Demon Lord does exist!
I wanted to shout it out loud, but without any solid proof, there was no way she'd believe me.
Mere words wouldn't even offer any comfort.
And even if I confessed that I'm Ria-senpai's Demon Lord, she'd be even less likely to believe that.
The Demon Lord Ria-senpai envisions might be a far cry from who I am, yet...
I've always wanted to become that very Demon Lord.

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Then I'll...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll become your Demon Lord, Senpai!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that no good...?」

name: Ria
message: 「*Giggle*」

name: Ria
message: 「Ufufu, oh, Synn-kun... Did I really look that down in the dumps?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, no... Well, how should I put it...」

name: Ria
message: 「Getting cheered up by my underclassman... I totally fail as a senpai~~」
More like comforting her than cheering her up, really.
When I tried to cram all sorts of feelings--like 'Sorry I'm the Demon Lord' and 'I'll prove I can be a splendid Demon Lord'--into words, that's what came out.

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, haven't you always said you looked up to the Demon Lord? Like a hero who'd save the world. And then you go and say they might not even exist...」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh dear, seems I gave you the wrong idea. Sorry about that.」

name: Ria
message: 「It might have sounded like I gave up on Re-Crea, but that's not it at all.」

name: Ria
message: 「Finding the Demon Lord I admired--that's the only thing I gave up on.」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, after admiring the Demon Lord so much...」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm~~ Maybe I don't look up to them quite so much anymore.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-Whaaat--!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Because they might not even exist, right? I can't just keep relying on someone like that forever.」

name: Synn
message: 「But then what's going to happen with Re-Crea?」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, I've got someone right by my side who's just as dependable as the Demon Lord. So I'll be fine.\s04」
W-Who is it...?

name: Ria
message: 「That person, you see, puts his heart into all sorts of things and works really, really hard.」

name: Ria
message: 「Normally he's a soothing type of guy with a gentle face, but when it counts he pulls through in a flash, so he's super reliable.」

name: Ria
message: 「What's more, he doesn't just do it for himself--he can give it his all for someone else's sake.」

name: Ria
message: 「For example, someone who wants everyone to have a sparkling, shining school life... or something like that.」

name: Ria
message: 「If I say this much, you already know who I'm talking about... right?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What am I even supposed to say to that...\s03」

name: Ria
message: 「So, you see. If you're going to become one, Synn-kun, you can't just be my Demon Lord--you have to become everyone's Demon Lord...\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... I-I'm sorry.」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee. You don't need to apologize.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's just... I didn't really mean it like that, so when you say it's for other people's sake... I feel guilty.」

name: Ria
message: 「Even for the upcoming Holy Night Festival, you're totally fired up to make sure everyone has fun, aren't you? That's why everyone agreed to go along with it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that really how it is...?」

name: Ria
message: 「Being able to do that naturally is what's so great about you, Synn-kun.\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「So hang in there. You've got to become everyone's Demon Lord, okay♪」

name: Synn
message: 「E-Enough with the Demon Lord talk already!」

name: Ria
message: 「It's not just me, you know. Even Big Sis looks up to that Demon Lord~」

name: Ria
message: 「The students at the academy, the people of Ryuusei Town, humans, angels, and demons--you have to become a Demon Lord that eeeveryone acknowledges.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yikes~~! Give me a break already~~!\s06」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee. I'm counting on you♪ Do your best~~♪」

name: Ria
message: 「The reason I don't look up to the Demon Lord anymore, you see... is because I found someone I care about even more than him...\s04」
